harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Used Ansible from node2 (the only node with ansible installed) as the control node to hold curl at its current pinned version on node1, via an idempotent dpkg_selections playbook. Verified functionally with a real system upgrade: curl stayed at 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 even though a newer version (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.15) was available and other packages upgraded. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both node1 and node2, proving boot-id changes and post-restart recovery of the hold and Ansible control connectivity.
actions_performed: Surveyed node1 (Ubuntu 24.04, curl 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8, no ansible) and node2 (ansible-core 2.20.5 installed) to identify node2 as the Ansible control node
Fixed node1 sshd (missing host keys via ssh-keygen -A, started ssh.service) so node2 could reach it over SSH
Installed node2's existing root SSH pubkey into node1's authorized_keys for passwordless Ansible connections
Wrote /root/ansible-curl-hold/inventory.ini and hold-curl.yml on node2 using ansible.builtin.dpkg_selections to hold curl on node1
Ran the playbook (changed=1 first run; ok/changed=0 on rerun, confirming idempotency)
Ran a real apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y on node1 and confirmed curl remained pinned at 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 (apt-mark showhold still lists curl) while unrelated packages upgraded
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baselines for both nodes
Restarted node1 (backgrounded reboot), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and reverified curl hold/version plus a no-op Ansible run from node2
Restarted node2 (backgrounded reboot), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and reverified ansible functionality, SSH connectivity to node1, and playbook idempotency

evidence.requirement: curl current version identified before hold
evidence.summary: dpkg -l curl on node1 shows installed version 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8

evidence.requirement: node2 identified as Ansible control node
evidence.summary: node2 has ansible/ansible-playbook installed; node1 does not

evidence.requirement: SSH connectivity established for Ansible
evidence.summary: Diagnosed and fixed node1 sshd (missing host keys), installed node2 pubkey, confirmed passwordless SSH root@node1 works

evidence.requirement: Ansible playbook created and applies the hold
evidence.summary: Inventory and dpkg_selections playbook written on node2; first run reports changed=1, before=install after=hold

evidence.requirement: Hold is idempotent / correctly applied
evidence.summary: apt-mark showhold and dpkg --get-selections show curl held; playbook rerun reports changed=0

evidence.requirement: Functional proof: system update leaves curl version unchanged
evidence.summary: Newer curl 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.15 was available; ran full apt-get upgrade -y; curl package version remained 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 afterward while other packages upgraded

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id 901ef286-c79c-44c0-ad2c-cfde1f6daa7a, ssh state, curl hold, and version before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged; connection timed out mid-reboot; boot_id changed to f90c5d43-5d0b-4b1a-a3d0-9ddab3693f8c after recovery

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: post-restart recovery proof
evidence.summary: curl still held at 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8, ssh.socket active; Ansible playbook from node2 reports ok/changed=0 confirming state and connectivity recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Captured node2 boot_id 6fd57414-83a2-4bff-91e3-33d229c2c635 and confirmed ansible functional before restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged; connection timed out mid-reboot; boot_id changed to 8a35b0d7-e0b3-4736-aadb-9792a2024187 after recovery

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: post-restart recovery proof
evidence.summary: ansible functional, SSH to node1 works, playbook files intact, and playbook rerun reports ok/changed=0 confirming full control-node recovery
